name: Log
caption: Log

configuration.description: Text written to the execution log at Info level. The key is case-sensitive and capitalised ('Message'). Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}. If the key is missing, an empty Info entry is written.

notes: No editor, publish or runtime checks exist for this step. It never fails on its own.
The entry goes to the run's execution log, not to a user-visible message. The flow continues normally.
